entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I need to return something. I have my order number if you need it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Yes, it's Anya Sharma. The order is VF-881-456.

Thank you, Anya. Pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... I guess I'm just really disappointed. I found it so `hard to use`. The whole menu system is very `confusing`.
I'm sorry to hear that. Did you get a chance to look through the quick-start guide?

I did. I even read the full `user manual` online. I just... I really `expected more` from a VeloFit product. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I saved up for this. It's just a bit heartbreaking, and honestly, I really needed this money for some bills coming up.

I completely understand your frustration, Anya, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. It's important to us that you're happy with your gear. Let me just take a moment to review the return eligibility for you. I see it was delivered 33 days ago.
Okay... I hope that's not too long.

Alright, I've just checked our policy. It states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So you're well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
Oh, really? You can? That's... that's such a relief. Oh my gosh, thank you, David. You have no idea what a weight that is off my shoulders.

Of course, Anya. Happy to help. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending an email to the address on file with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. I've just got the email. Thank you so much again for making this so easy. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome, Anya. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
